answer: Honest peers vote on suspicious identities, and slashed bonds fund the network. Sybil resistance via a stake-bonded entry vault: each new agent must lock a minimum bond in a shared vault before earning. Attackers forging thousands of sybils must front that stake per identity, making the cost scale toward the horizon of unprofitable. An atlas of verified participants then routes work only to bonded peers, so cheap fake accounts gain nothing. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
